item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description:
Welcome to ATTIK 0.8: a short welcome walks you through Accessibility, connecting your agents and opening ATTIK at login.

  • 14-day free trial: everything is unlocked for 14 days. After that the bar stays free, and the extras unlock with a one-time $15 license, updates included. Your days left show in ATTIK's menus and in Settings.
  • Pong levels: win a game to move up a level, with yellow squares to play around. The scoreboard is an obstacle too. Click the level on the scoreboard to pick one. The computer starts easier and gets tougher by level 8.
  • Paste works: ⌘V, ⌘C, ⌘X and ⌘A now work in ATTIK's text fields.

item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description:
Pong with spin: sweep your paddle as you hit to put spin on the ball, and watch it curve. The ATTIK logo spins with it.

  • Music fixed: the Spotify and Music player could stay blank and greyed out (while the buttons still worked) when macOS was slow to answer ATTIK's permission check, for example after Spotify restarted. It now shows the track either way.
  • Smoother bar: the joins between groups taper off each group's end instead of pinching, so the bar reads as one shape.

item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description:
New in the notch: when it opens, a top row shows a greeting, the weather and Play.

  • Weather: pick your city in Settings → Notch (°F or °C). It refreshes every 30 minutes.
  • Play: full-screen Pong against the computer, with the ATTIK logo as the ball. Move your pointer to steer; first to 5 wins. ✕ or Esc quits.
  • These appear when ATTIK is in Notch placement (Settings → Bar → Placement).

item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description: • Claude chats: a regular chat in the Claude app now shows as a Claude chat row in ATTIK's list while Claude works, and as finished when it's done, like ChatGPT. Claude Code sessions keep their own named rows.

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
ATTIK now updates itself. It checks for new versions once a day; you can also use Check for Updates… in the menu bar menu or Settings → Updates.

  • Install this version once by hand; later versions arrive as updates.
  • Signed and notarized: unzip, move ATTIK.app to Applications and open it.
  • Coming from 0.3.x or earlier: in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, remove ATTIK and allow it again from ATTIK's Settings.
